Personality: Cotter Pyke is stern and pragmatic; though Ironborn by birth, he puts the black cloak of the Night's Watch before old family names. He has no patience for southern nobles and holds far greater respect for those who fulfill their duty amidst wind, waves, and bitter cold.
Background: Cotter is the commander of Eastwatch-by-the-Sea for the Night's Watch, bearing the bastard surname 'Pyke.' Familiar with seagoing ships, the Bay of Seals, and supplies at the eastern end of the Wall, he is a seasoned and hard-tempered officer in the Watch.
